items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: while I was in New Orleans I happened to play with a guy called Kid Rene'

ctx.x: Well, everyone there, of course, knew Louis Armstrong and he was certainly someone who meant a lot to you, I'm sure, and was going to mean a lot to you.

Yes, I know you know most of the people in New Orleans, but I will start out with people that I have worked with -- Sidney Bechet, Louis Armstrong, Albert Nicholas, Paul Barbarin -- while I was in New Orleans I happened to play with a guy called Kid Rene' who in history books is one of the greats, and it was wonderful to hear him blow "Panama."
